episode_metrics_tracker.What is the difference between success_o: Contrast ever reaching the goal with being in the goal state at the last step. Cover a robot that succeeds then knocks the object away, and why the two coincide when a success terminates the episode.
episode_metrics_tracker.Why does a vectorized robot environment: Think about thousands of envs stepping in one batch but finishing at different steps under partial resets. Cover what a single shared total would mix together and which buffers each env needs.
episode_metrics_tracker.With same-step autoreset, why must the e: Follow the order inside one step: record, snapshot, reset the finished envs. Cover what in-place zeroing does to a tensor the caller still holds, and where ManiSkill puts the finished episode's numbers.
episode_metrics_tracker.What changes in the metrics when ignore_: Cover what ends an episode once terminations are ignored (only truncation), what the returned terminations become, and why success_at_end only carries extra information when the episode runs to the time limit.
episode_metrics_tracker.How do Gymnasium's NEXT_STEP and SAME_ST: Compare when the reset happens relative to the done step in each mode. Cover which step's reward and length belong to which episode, and when the running statistics must be zeroed in each case.
episode_metrics_tracker.Partial resets versus running every envi: Weigh simulator throughput and fresh episodes against a fixed horizon for every env. Cover which mode lets you report success_at_end, and how ManiSkill's PPO baseline splits training and evaluation between the two.
episode_metrics_tracker.Averaging finished-episode metrics per s: Think about which episodes finish more often in a fixed number of steps. Cover what averaging the done-step snapshot does to short versus long episodes, and how a per-episode or fixed-episode-count evaluation fixes it.
